title: Nothing confirms layoffs, but calls market exit rumors ‘fake news’
description: In response to a report that Nothing is planning to "exit 12 markets as global shipments decline," Nothing cofounder Akis Evangelidis said the company is "reorganizing" and laying off some of its staff, but that "the reported numbers are way overblown."
